rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-2: ONE knob changed vs iter-1 (img_n_bf 1->3); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_01.json (job that scored val_score 0.6657, hr +0.2763, PSNR 19.47 vs LD-FBP 16.67 baseline -- the best of the 4 demo_dl N2I runs and ALREADY above baseline). The lever here is to push HIGHER, not just clear baseline. Design-doc hint (solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md 'Hints for the next autoresearch agent'): the projection-domain stack is in the symmetry trap on phantoms (proj sigmas near-identity -> stacked proj BFs stay locked-symmetric, proj_n_bf increase = wasted params), so spend the parameter budget on the IMAGE side. The image-domain stack 'readily differentiates into a multi-scale cascade (BF1 mild + tight sigma_r, BF2 wider, BF3 widest)'. img_n_bf 1->3 grows the image denoiser from 3 to 9 trainable scalars (total network 6->12 params, still ultra-low) for a genuine multi-scale image-domain cascade. Held fixed: proj_n_bf=1 (no point stacking the near-identity proj filter), kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), all six sigma inits (proj 1.0/2.0/0.02, img 1.5/1.5/0.02), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 (-> identical val split, directly comparable to iter-1). Wall: iter-1 ran 126 s; adding 2 image-domain BFs per FBP roughly 2-3x the per-step image cost but image-domain is a tiny fraction of the 128-view FBP+proj cost, so well under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard. Hypothesis: a 3-deep image-domain bilateral cascade gives the denoiser multi-scale capacity (coarse smoothing + edge-preserving fine pass) that a single image BF cannot, lifting val_score above iter-1's 0.6657 without the proj-stack symmetry waste -- and without enough parameters to memorise (12 scalars). If it does NOT move val_score, that confirms the image-domain BF is also near its structural ceiling on this dense phantom substrate and the next iter should pivot to img kernel/sigma tuning instead of depth.
